summary: Locked the already-approved B API semantics as Draft 2020-12 schemas, strict offline references, 18 synthetic request/response vectors, a transport handoff, and a hash-checked contract validator. No business service, route, frontend, fixture, approval record, or independent verification report was created or changed.

acceptance_results.criterion: All $ref values resolve offline, use Draft 2020-12, and apply actual timezone-aware date-time validation; positive vectors pass and negative vectors reject.

A34, P0/E1 precedence, H1=350, A29 action expression, server time, notification confirmation, HTTP errors, cache visibility, candidate expiry, unknown cases, and event de-duplication have machine-contract mappings.
Model candidates cannot produce final activation, evidence, responsibility, decision, or approved resolution; new response schemas do not add endpoints.
Exact C/A files and vectors are handed off without modifying frontend or fixtures; unaccepted external work remains gated.
The BATCH-01 approval archive is read-only, has the required content hash, and is supported by BATCH-01/BATCH-02 PASS integration receipts.

not_completed.reason: Explicitly outside BATCH-03; the batch only locks contracts.

not_completed.item: Independent BATCH-03 verification report and verification evidence
not_completed.reason: Reserved for the independent verifier; this implementation did not create or overwrite them.

not_completed.reason: C owns TypeScript/examples; A owns fixtures/ground truth. Their current external statuses remain unchanged.

remaining_risks: BATCH-03 has implementation evidence only, not independent verification or coordinator integration.
C must synchronize the named TypeScript contract and examples before X-C-CONTRACT can become accepted.
A-owned fixture, ground-truth, and image gates remain MISSING and continue to block their downstream integrations.
The offline checker requires an available jsonschema runtime; this run reused existing local tooling without changing dependency locks.

rollback.code: Revert the implementation-report commit first, then revert 2e0437c. Do not reset, edit the approval archive, or partially revert only a subset of locked schemas.
rollback.runtime_state: NOT_APPLICABLE: no service, database, model, external notification, or business state was created.
